headline: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Chief Supports Proposed Financial Audit
seoTitle: FFI Chief Supports PSSI Financial Audit Plan
metaDescription: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Chairman Michael Sianipar welcomes the PSSI proposal to conduct an audit of the organization's non-government financial records.
aiSummaryBullets: FFI Chairman Michael Sianipar expressed support for the PSSI plan to audit the federation's non-APBN finances.
The initiative aims to examine funds sourced from entities other than the national state budget.
Sianipar acknowledged the importance of funding contributions from both government and private sector stakeholders.
aiContextParagraph: The Federasi Futsal Indonesia (FFI) is currently responding to a proposal from the Football Association of Indonesia (PSSI) regarding a comprehensive audit of the futsal federation's financial activities. PSSI Secretary General Yunus Nusi initiated the discourse on auditing funds that are categorized as non-APBN, or those originating outside of the state budget. In response, FFI Chairman Michael Sianipar officially welcomed the move, characterizing the planned oversight as a positive development for the organization. Sianipar further emphasized the necessity of balancing financial support from governmental bodies with private sector contributions to maintain the federation's operational integrity. This discussion highlights the ongoing collaboration and oversight procedures between the national football governing body and the independent futsal organization as they seek to clarify funding transparency and organizational governance standards within the national sports infrastructure.
